helpLabel: How to Play. gina: Z  C. rae: ←  →. WALK OFF EDGES TO DESCEND. PUSH EACH OTHER. CONTACT DOES NOT HURT. BEER +3 HP. SAFE LANDING +1 HP. SPIKES -4. CEILING -5. MAX LIFE 12. FIRST TO DIE OR FALL OFF-SCREEN LOSES. EVERY 10 FLOORS = 0.5 shot. Enter to start. B returns to title.
